pages.text:
Progress Test Files 5–7
Listening 1
Tim
Where did you go yesterday evening, Sarah?
Sarah
Well, I wanted to go to the cinema with Amy but she
wasn’t well, so we stayed in and watched a film on TV.
Tim
Oh, right. What did you watch?
Sarah
Well, there was a good French film on Channel 1
– Summer in the City. But Amy saw it in the cinema last
month so she didn’t want to watch it. In the end, we
watched Wonderful Night on Channel 4.
Tim
What did you think of it?
Sarah
Well, it was a romantic film and usually I don’t really like
romantic films. But it was OK. It wasn’t great but it was
OK.
Tim
Who was in the film?
Sarah
Er … oh, I don’t know. The tall Australian actor, what’s his
name?
Tim
Paul Rogers?
Sarah
Yes. That’s right. And the American singer, Jessica Low. She
was very good but he was terrible. I don’t think he’s a very
good actor … What was the last film you saw, Tim?
Tim
Me? Oh, I don’t have a TV so I don’t see films very often.
But the last time I went to the cinema I saw Lost Weekend.
Sarah
Lost Weekend? I don’t know it. Was it good?
Tim
Yeah. Well, I liked it.
Progress Test Files 5–7
Listening 2
1
Jo
Where were you at seven o’clock yesterday evening,
Chris?
Chris
Er … I got back from work at half past six, so I was at
home, I think. Jack was out. He was still at work then.
Why?
Jo
Oh, no reason. I just wanted to know where you were.
2
Mum
How was your day at school, Simon?
Simon
Oh, it was OK. We had Maths in the morning with Miss
Stewart, then we had English. That was OK but Mr Jones
was angry because I didn’t do my homework. Then, after
lunch and PE, it’s usually History, but today we didn’t
have History because we went to the museum on a school
trip. That was boring and I lost my bag …
Mum
You lost your bag, Simon. Oh no. That’s awful.
3
Pete
When’s your birthday, Claire?
Claire
Oh, it’s on the sixteenth of next month.
Pete
Well, it’s the fifth of May today, so tomorrow then?
Claire
No. Listen. I said the sixteenth. And next month. I like
having a birthday in June because it’s usually sunny.
4
Sandra
Did Janice have a nice time in Rome?
Maureen
Oh yes, she had a wonderful time. She and Gary rented
a lovely apartment for the summer and worked at the
language school there.
Sandra
That’s nice. I thought they stayed in a hotel.
Maureen
Well, that was the plan at first. But it’s nicer to have
your own place, isn’t it?
5
Jason
What are you going to do when you finish university,
May?
May
Oh, well, I want to travel but I don’t have any money. So,
I’m going to work for my dad’s business for six months to
get some money.
Jason
Are you going to travel then?
May
Oh, I don’t know. It depends on the job. If I like it, I’m
going to stay.
